build_input: Approved objective: enable easy HTTPS localhost serving for the static game.
implementation_summary: `./serve.sh --https` now defaults to `https://localhost:8443` unless `PORT` or `--port` is set.
`serve.sh` now uses `dev-cert.pem`/`dev-key.pem` by default, preserves explicit `TLS_CERT`/`TLS_KEY`, and generates a self-signed localhost cert when missing or missing localhost SAN.
Explicit custom TLS usage now requires both `TLS_CERT` and `TLS_KEY` and does not regenerate custom cert files.
`https_server.py` now uses the same local cert/key defaults, generates/refreshes only default local certs when needed, uses `ThreadingHTTPServer`, and supports `HOST`/`PORT` env overrides.
README quickstart now documents the one-command HTTPS flow and self-signed browser warning.
